name: probe-rows-v2-long
description: The v2 probe rows of the TerminalEnv degradation matrix at the team's long settings, as docs/inkling_probes_amendment_5.md fixes them: amendment 3's two configs (trained against probe_iid or probe_ood, the follow-up readout, penalty_coef 1.0) with 360 steps and lr 2e-4, the settings of the team's '-lr-2e-4-long' judge rows and controls of 2026-11-02..04 (W&B jyudel-redwood-research/terminal-env-inkling-small). Three runs against probe_iid on seeds 231-233 and three against probe_ood on seeds 234-236. Everything else is amendment 3's: KL 1e-4, LoRA rank 8, 8 prompts x 16 samples, an eval every 3 steps, the four Qwen judges held out and scored live, early stop off. The team's three long controls (seeds 213-215) are the control row.
